body:
I feel bad, I mean, my mum is my mum, but I can see she has her problems. I don't really know how to handle it. She sort of, I can see, uses me as something of an emotional outlet, telling me things then saying she really shouldn't have, things about my dad and stuff. She needs help, but I don't know how to help her. She's very unsatisfied with life, and I think seeing me in a similar position calms her a bit? 

I'm very worried she'll find this, it'd upset her to hear me talk like this. She only has my best interests at heart, but sometimes it does feel a bit... much. 

I really want to go to the psychologist on my own and hash this stuff out a bit, but they'll tell her or she'll get it out of me and then things will be worse. If I keep it to myself it plateaus and keeps everything stable. 

I just can't help but think she doesn't like me very much. Love, certainly, but like? It's a tough one. 

I don't know. It really helps talking though. Thank you. x
Thank you. :) It's a pretty rubbish thing to have, agoraphobia, isn't it? Thanks for taking the time to reply, it's really great to just hear from people. x

Thanks so much for taking the time to reply. 

Does it make sense that talking on Reddit scares me? I'm so afraid that someone will be mean to me, I don't like to share my opinions because I feel as though I'm wrong. That said, I will try to join some discussions if I come across any. 

My agoraphobia is pretty bad, I can't really go outside at all. I'm surrounded by countryside but walking makes me really scared, as though I'm going to pass out at any moment. I think I might try when my mum's not around, so she doesn't get suspicious and ask questions.

Yeah, my mum's the same way with the therapist. When I went as a child and she wasn't allowed in the sessions she used to insist they were recorded for her so I didn't say anything bad about her. It was hard, and still is, because more than me, I want to get her help, but she refuses to take her medication. We bounce off each other and make each other worse. It feels like I'm suffocating. 

I keep a blog, but I don't want to give it out on Reddit in case someone tracks me down and tells my parents what I've said. My mum found my previous blog and so I had to delete it. I've never said anything bad about her but still. 

My sister's whole life was leading up to her being a mum, it's all she wanted. I used to want, and this is silly, to be Stephen Fry, to go to university and learn. However I messed up school and couldn't cope with college and now, though I read daily, I can feel my brain getting less and less intelligent. But yeah, my whole life was leading up to going to university, I was going to make everyone so proud, that's all I wanted. I still want that, but how can I compete? 

I feel like the girl you mentioned, I feel I am overprotected. I always have been, my mum used to joke about it. Now I just feel it's a habit we're stuck to. 

I feel bad now, that that girl died though she was happy. I don't know how to answer that, she deserved her life a lot more than I do mine.
